sections.title: Info Box
sections.content:
The info box is used for neutral informational callouts.

[BOX:info]This is an info box. Use it to highlight contextual information that helps the reader understand background details without implying urgency or caution.[/BOX]

sections.title: Success Box
sections.content:
The success box is used for positive outcomes, confirmations, or recommendations.

[BOX:success]This is a success box. Use it to highlight completed actions, positive results, or recommended approaches.[/BOX]

sections.title: Warning Box
sections.content:
The warning box draws attention to important caveats or potential issues.

[BOX:warning]This is a warning box. Use it when the reader should exercise caution or be aware of a limitation or prerequisite.[/BOX]

sections.title: Note Box
sections.content:
The note box is used for supplementary information that is relevant but not critical.

[BOX:note]This is a note box. Use it to provide additional context, technical details, or references that complement the main content.[/BOX]

sections.title: KPI Blocks
sections.content:
KPI blocks display key metrics in a visually prominent format. Four colour variants are available.

[KPI:navy|Total Pipelines|14,293]

[KPI:blue|Active Users|847]

[KPI:jade|Uptime|99.97%]

[KPI:orange|Open Issues|12]

sections.title: Feature Blocks
sections.content:
Feature blocks highlight product capabilities or key differentiators. Four colour variants are available.

[FEATURE:navy|Enterprise Security]
Full SSO integration, role-based access control, and audit logging across all platform actions.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:blue|AI-Powered Integration]
SnapGPT generates pipelines from natural language descriptions, reducing build time by up to 80%.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:jade|Real-Time Monitoring]
Live dashboards and alerting for all pipeline executions, with drill-down into individual snap performance.
[/FEATURE]

[FEATURE:orange|Hybrid Deployment]
Run Snaplexes on-premises, in the cloud, or at the edge — managed from a single control plane.
[/FEATURE]

sections.title: Boxes with Surrounding Content
sections.content:
Boxes should integrate cleanly with surrounding paragraphs and lists.

Here is a paragraph before a box. It should render at normal body text size with correct spacing.

[BOX:info]This box appears between two paragraphs. The spacing above and below should be consistent.

It also contains multiple paragraphs inside the box itself to verify internal spacing.[/BOX]

Here is a paragraph after the box. Formatting should resume normally here with no residual indentation or spacing issues.

- List item one
- List item two
- List item three

[BOX:warning]This warning appears after a list. Verify that list spacing does not bleed into the box.[/BOX]

Final paragraph confirming clean termination.

sections.title: All Boxes in Sequence
sections.content:
All four box types displayed consecutively to verify visual consistency and spacing.

[BOX:info]Info: Platform supports 700+ pre-built connectors across SaaS, cloud, and on-premises systems.[/BOX]
